name: A Two-Unit Wing Resolves Every Opposite Profile through Two Units
statement: Let a cornerless ample two-layer family have overlap $B$ of order at most nine. If one wing has two-cycle holonomy and excess two while the opposite wing has two-cycle holonomy and excess at most two, then their acquired supports contain three pairwise disjoint direction pairs.
proof: The exact excess classification leaves five feasible two-unit normal forms. Constructing these from a pure $P_7$ completion or wedges of rooted ample gates of orders at most five yields 148 distinct embedded ample overlaps and 960 exact two-unit markers. The audit compares distinct markers against every opposite two-unit, sharp, eta-one, and pair-rich extra-owner marker, while coincident markers immediately repeat both terminal supports and the rooted-claw theorem handles all pair-poor extra-owner markers. All 8395 distinct comparisons end in a repeated acquired support, passive-shielding contradiction, forced-owner conflict, direct terminal matching, or collar-augmented matching; each outcome respectively contradicts the structural identities or yields three independent acquired pairs.
comments: For distinct markers the outcome counts are: opposite two-unit 3131 repeated-terminal, 1930 terminal-matching, 117 distant-corner, 347 owner-conflict, 112 repeated-collar, 238 collar-matching; sharp 121,49,0,0,0,7; eta-one 791,260,12,66,0,0; pair-rich extra-owner 718,334,0,94,0,68.
